Create and manage agents: Agents overview; Build a declarative agent; Build a custom engine agent;
Evaluate agents; **Use Insights Agent (preview)** (reported 2026-08-07); Manage agents in the
Microsoft 365 admin center.
Extend with plugins and connectors: API plugins for declarative agents; Copilot connectors; build a
custom Copilot connector.
Developer tools and APIs: M365 Agents Toolkit; M365 Agents SDK; Work IQ API; Microsoft 365 Copilot
APIs; Microsoft Agent 365.

Graph changelog: the HTML page is still JS-rendered (nav only). The RSS feed
https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/changelog/rss/ renders and **DID advance this scan**:
newest item is now **Mon, 10 Aug 2026 — Tenants** (crossTenantMigrationJob gains a `migrate` method;
`validate` method behavior changed; displayName, completeAfterDateTime, sourceTenantId,
exchangeSettings, workloads, resourceType and resources parameters removed). This is generic Graph
tenant-migration churn, NOT AI/agent related, so it is **held below the reporting bar**. Prior items
are all still June 17-19, 2026 (Security DLP policyTip, Tasks and Plans history resources, Teamwork
cloudVideoInteropInfo, Identity accessPackageSuggestion framework, Applications redirectUris). Still
no Copilot / AI / declarative-agent / Agent 365 entries anywhere in the feed.

M365 admin What's New in preview (whats-new-in-preview, ms.date 2026-05-19, updated_at 2026-06-23):
newest section is still **November 2025**. No change.

NOTE (cross-reference, 2026-08-10): the "Microsoft Agent 365" link in this nav is the entry point to
a GA agent control plane that this monitor had never covered — see azure-ai-foundry_changelog.txt and
the 2026-08-10 report. Agent 365's registry includes M365/Copilot-surfaced agents and discovers
**shadow agents** in the tenant.
